read-effects-no-mutation.note: Successful read: effects Known, no changed paths, bytes and mtime unchanged.

read-permissions-protected-outside.note: Protected and outside-workspace reads refused without leaking bytes.

read-recovery-retry-after-failure.note: A failed read does not poison a later read after the file appears.

read-cancel-before-start.note: Pre-cancelled read returns Aborted/Effects none-like refusal without content.

read-concurrency-identical-text.note: Four concurrent reads of one file return identical text.

read-presentation-numbered.note: Numbered line presentation and paging (existing test).

write-permissions-authorizer-denial.note: Per-path controller authorizer denial commits nothing; only actual mutations reported.

write-concurrency-racing-revision.note: Racing revision after planning fails before any commit.

edit-effects-atomic-refusal.note: Mixed batch is an atomic refusal; stale tag refused without writing (existing test).

edit-permissions-authorizer-denial.note: Denied authorization leaves file and observers untouched.

edit-cancel-racing-source.note: Cancellation and changed-source recheck before commit (existing test). Same test covers the racing-writer concurrency cell.

edit-presentation-projection.note: Successful edit projection keeps fresh anchors and raw diff (existing test).

search-effects-permissions-protected.note: One test covers both: grep/glob change nothing (Known, no changed paths) and skip protected paths.

search-recovery-cursor-resume.note: Cursor resume after a page matches serial results (existing test).

search-concurrency-parallel-serial.note: Parallel and serial pages are byte identical (existing test).

search-presentation-context.note: Context line merge and group separation (existing test).

findings.evidence: Native audit observed tools::edit::hashline::tests::returning_to_a_retained_version_keeps_intervening_unchanged_witnesses fail at hashline/tests.rs:880: unchanged line 2 was not retained as witnessed. Module summary: 161 passed, 1 failed, 1 ignored. See benchmarks/tool-audit-session-native/edit-contracts.log and its hashed run receipt.
findings.cause: Unchanged witness propagation happened only when creating a new snapshot, not when a retained version reappeared. The owner moved propagation before the snapshot-reuse branch. The failure was observed during active development, not established as a released regression.
findings.next_action: Retain the regression test and independently verify the linked failing-before and passing-after receipts on stable source.
findings.fix: Carry unchanged witnesses from the latest observation before either reusing or creating a hashline snapshot; independently verify edit-contracts after the owner fix.
